primitives.name: Canonical URL Structural Integrity Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Write for humans — it shows in search result snippets.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C(u)': 'Binary indicator function (dimensionless)', 'u': 'URL string', 'U_{valid}': 'Set of all valid, non-trivial, non-duplicate URLs'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a well-formed URL syntax and that the system has a global registry of acceptable URL variants.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when a URL contains invalid characters or is a duplicate of another canonical URL.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Conformal Inference framework for URL validity prediction and GSE's State-Transition logic for handling URL rewrite failures.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of HTTP 4XX errors due to malformed URLs, percentage of duplicate canonical tags in HTML responses.

primitives.name: Open Graph Image Generation Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Cover video (`og_video_url`).** The animated counterpart of the cover image — the Higgsfield feed plays it on the website's card.
primitives.latex: G(I, P) = I' \quad \text{where } I' = f(I) \circ g(P)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I': 'Source image tensor (RGB channels × height × width)', 'P': 'User prompt / configuration parameters', "I'": 'Generated Open Graph image', 'f': 'Image processing transformation function', 'g': 'Template composition function'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the availability of an image generation model and that user prompts are semantically consistent with the source image context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when the generated image exceeds platform size limits or contains elements violating content policies.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian ranking models for predicting optimal image formats and GSE's Situational Reasoning for adaptive resource allocation during image rendering.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of image generation requests, average generation time, and ratio of policy-compliant images served to clients.

primitives.name: Sitemap XML Document Generator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Commit + deploy — the metadata (and the feed card) update on the next deploy, like every other `app-meta.json` change.
primitives.latex: S = \bigcup_{r \in R} \left\langle loc: u_r, lastmod: t_r, changefreq: c_r, priority: p_r \right\rangle
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Sitemap XML document (string)', 'R': 'Set of all published routes', 'u_r': 'Canonical URL string for route r', 't_r': 'Last modification timestamp for route r', 'c_r': 'Change frequency category (static, weekly, monthly)', 'p_r': 'Priority weight (0.0 to 1.0)'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a static mapping between route identifiers and their corresponding URLs, and that timestamps are accurately maintained.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime failure happens when the sitemap exceeds the 50MB limit or contains URLs that return HTTP 404 errors.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSI's Information Retrieval ranking functions and maps to GSE's Event-Driven architecture for on-demand sitemap updates.
layer2.telemetry: Size of the generated sitemap, number of excluded URLs, and crawl coverage metrics from search console APIs.
